description: login with AGENT_DRIVE_API_URL set to the bare origin (the form the console panel shows) fails with `Agent Drive refused the login request: 404`; adding /api works. Probably a local-dev routing difference (prod serves /oauth/... at the origin) but the message gives no recovery hint.
expected: Either the origin works or the error says to use the /api URL.
suggested_fix: Print the URL that returned 404 and hint at the /api form.

description: CLI login prints `Ignored a different API URL returned by the server.` with no explanation of what was ignored or whether it matters.
expected: Silent or one line saying which URL is used.

description: The delegate checkbox needed for credentials issue/grant is only inside collapsed Details on /connect; the summary 'New encrypted drive · full access' does not mention it, and the success page does not say delegate was granted.
expected: Visible hint or the CLI telling the owner to tick it.
suggested_fix: Show delegate state on the approval summary and success page.

description: Pasting the printed line with its prefix gives `AGENT_DRIVE_CREDENTIALS is not a valid credentials bundle.` The printed line includes the prefix, docs say to paste only the part after `=`, and the error never says so.
expected: Message names the prefix mistake or the CLI accepts the prefix.
actual: `AGENT_DRIVE_CREDENTIALS is not a valid credentials bundle.`
suggested_fix: Strip a leading `AGENT_DRIVE_CREDENTIALS=` or mention it in the error.

description: Web Files popover says `Key backed up 11/27/2026 (env)` while the laptop CLI says `drive key not backed up` and `credentials status` says backedUp:false. The sandbox bundle (method env) marked the drive backed up server-side, masking that the laptop has no backup.
expected: One consistent backup state; 'env' not shown to users.
actual: Web: backed up; CLI: not backed up
suggested_fix: Track backup per machine/key or word the web state as 'a sandbox holds a copy'.

description: Console panel says `Run the CLI from the repository after building it.` and shows origin-only `--api`, contradicting npm install instructions elsewhere.
expected: Same install and --api guidance as docs.

description: API keys rows repeat the agent name three times and use `issued by <machine>` in the label while the Agents tab says `issued by <agent name>`. No drive is named on the key row.
suggested_fix: Use agent name as issuer in labels; drop the third repeat; add drive name.

description: Agents rows show no scopes, delegate status or write paths and the laptop agent's Revoke access looks the same as CI rows, so a user cannot tell which identity can mint others or is the one they are using.
expected: Badge for 'can add agents' and write paths.
actual: Only name, UUID, active key count
suggested_fix: Add scope/delegate and write-path summary to agent rows.

description: `--write-path ci/nightly` fails with `writePaths must be a canonical absolute POSIX path.` (API field name and jargon, no example).
actual: writePaths must be a canonical absolute POSIX path.
suggested_fix: Reword with flag name and example.
